etsy.description:
Cardinals and Coffee mug wrap design as a PNG digital download, ready for sublimation. ☕ Theme: folk art cardinal, bird watching, cozy winter.

✨ WHAT YOU GET
• 2 PNG files at 300 DPI with transparent background
• 11oz mug wrap: 2550 x 1050 px (8.5 x 3.5 in)
• 15oz mug wrap: 2625 x 1140 px (8.75 x 3.8 in)
• The design is placed on BOTH sides of the mug, so it faces the drinker in the left or right hand

🖨 HOW TO USE
Print on sublimation paper (mirror the image if your printer setup needs it) and press onto a sublimation mug. Works with Cricut Mug Press and heat presses. Colors may print slightly differently depending on your printer, paper and ink.

📄 LICENSE
Personal use and small business use up to 200 finished mugs. You may not resell, share or redistribute the digital file itself.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Want the finished mug instead? You'll find it in our shop.
